Subject: POC provisioning playback & cutover cadence

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I drafted a concise playback of the POC provisioning steps so your infra team can validate dependencies before we lock dates. High level:

- Org setup: we need a NovusHealth org id (will map to our tenant) and one owner-level user for API key generation.
- API keys: Redwood will provision a scoped API key for the evaluation; we ask that you rotate it after the POC.
- IP allowlist: please provide the outbound CIDR list for your egress gateways; we will share Redwood’s egress IPs for the allowlist.
- VPC peering: exchange peering configs and a shared subnet block; the attached vpc-peering-template.yaml is our minimal required fields.

I attached a one-page milestone workbook with proposed dates and cutover triggers ("20261117-map-milestones.xlsx"). Proposed target: environment live for test traffic by 2026-11-23, smoke tests on 11/24, and backlog evaluation week 11/25–11/29.

Can you confirm: 1) a NovusHealth owner email for org creation, and 2) whether your security team needs any additional evidence (SOC2, data flow diagram) before schedule? If you prefer, we can keep the schedule flexible pending your peering maintenance window.

Next step: once you confirm owner and peering window I’ll loop in Aditya to provision the API key and route the VPC request to networking.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park

3) Peering window: network maintenance is on 11/21 so we should avoid heavy changes that day. 11/23 looks good for a peering handshake on our side.

Kimberly / Aditya —

Quick updates after I reviewed the template and chatted with network:

- Template looks fine; we need Novus to confirm the exact peer ASN and confirm public vs private IPs for BGP. I added inline comments in the Drive file.
- I will raise the peering ticket with Network Ops today (ETA 24 hours to get initial review).
- Regarding the IP allowlist: Redwood will publish a concise egress CIDR set — we typically provide 3 /24 ranges. Aditya, I’ll need the list from you by 11/22 as planned.
- API key: Aditya, please generate the key with these constraints: scope=completion, embeddings=false, ttl=7d, qps_limit=100. Send through the vault link and confirm the vault token to Ellen only.

Ellen — for your preflight checklist, here are the items we recommend (short version you can paste into a runbook):
1) Confirm peering routes are accepted and pingable across a small ICMP window.
2) Verify firewall rules allow outbound 443 to Redwood egress CIDRs.
3) Validate API key can fetch model metadata and run a 5-example prompt smoke test.
4) Run a small load test (50 rps for 2 mins) to confirm token quotas.

I’ll update the Drive milestone workbook with the peering ticket number and initial ETA. If Novus can provide ASN and any proxy IPs (you mentioned proxy earlier), we can tighten the plan and avoid the 11/21 maintenance window.

—Marissa
